DIS.rationale: Disney presents a moderately attractive setup anchored by three converging positives: (1) operating fundamentals are stable-to-improving — Q2 FY2026 operating income of $4.60B grew +3.6% YoY on +6.5% revenue growth, streaming SVOD operating income surged 88% to $582M with margin crossing 10%, and Experiences continues to post record results; (2) valuation has de-rated significantly with PE compressing 34% from 22.6x to 14.9x (near the 12-month floor of 12.5x) and P/B at 1.60x at the bottom of its range, despite largely intact operating fundamentals; and (3) a credible near-term catalyst exists in Q3 FY2026 earnings reported on the decision date showing EPS beat, streaming profit doubling, and reaffirmed double-digit adjusted EPS growth guidance for FY2026-2027, plus the $1.2B A+E sale simplifying the portfolio. The principal offset is the widening gap between operating income and net income (EPS -29.8% YoY), which signals below-the-line drag that the market's de-rating may be correctly discounting. Cash flow volatility (OCF swinging from $735M to $6.91B between consecutive quarters) and a thin 73bp earnings yield spread over Baa corporates limit conviction at higher scores. The score of +0.35 reflects a solid fundamental franchise with improving trajectory and a meaningful valuation discount, tempered by genuine earnings-quality concerns that prevent a stronger rating.
